qguide.s1_body:
First, run **`/queue`** once.

The bot asks **which of your channels** it should use, it creates none:
• an **admin** channel (your control panel, staff only)
• an **announcements** channel (where players join with ✅)
• a **waiting voice** channel (where they gather before the game)

You pick from a dropdown, nothing to type.
qguide.s2_body:
Type **`/queue`** in the **queue** channel.

A panel appears with buttons. Set up whatever you want:

📛 **Title**: the game name (Valorant, CS2...)
👥 **Teams**: how many teams (2 to 6)
🎯 **Players**: how many players per team
✏️ **Names**: name and color of each team
🕒 **Time**: when it starts
📢 **Channel**: where to post the announcement

➡️ Nothing is mandatory: the defaults work fine for a first try.
qguide.s3_body:
Click **✅ Start**.

What happens:
• the announcement is posted with an **@everyone**
• the waiting voice channel opens for those who sign up
• you get a **private preview** (only you see it)
• a **🚀 Launch / 🛑 Cancel** panel appears in the queue channel

➡️ Players react with **✅** on the announcement. They get the **Connexion** role and can join the waiting voice channel.
qguide.s4_body:
When everyone is there, click **🚀 Launch the game**.

The bot handles everything:
• a voice announces the start in the waiting channel
• players are **split into teams** automatically
• one **voice channel per team** is created, and everyone is moved into it
• the waiting channel closes (nobody else can join)

➡️ Changed your mind before launching? **🛑 Cancel** cleans everything up.
qguide.s5_body:
In the **queue** channel, the **Score tracker** panel has one button per team.

• Click a team → **+1 point**
• The history shows the time of each point

When it's over, click **🏁 Finish**:
• the result goes to **queue-result**
• the **leaderboard** updates (wins, losses, streaks)
• team channels are deleted
• the announcement switches to "Match finished" with shortcuts

⚠️ **Launch the game before scoring points**, otherwise the teams are empty and the leaderboard won't move.
qguide.s6_body:
**To organize**
`/queue`: create a queue
`/schedule`: post it automatically (presets: several ready-made queues)
`/rematch`: replay the last game in one click
`/poll`: a poll to pick the game or the time
`/history`: recent games
`/bl`: block a disruptive player · `/unbl`: unblock them

**For players**
`/leaderboard`: the server leaderboard
`/stats`: your statistics
`/roles notif`: post the panel to get DM alerts

**Settings**
`/podium`: the season hall of fame
`/season`: reset the leaderboard every month

**If something's off**
`/diagnostic`: checks that everything works (permissions, channels, roles)
`/help`: every command sorted by category

duel.panel_desc:
A **duel team** is temporary: it plays the number of duels chosen when it was created, then disappears. It is **not a clan**, you can be in a clan and in a team.

`/createteam` creates your team · `/duel <team> <rounds>` challenges another team.
duel.panel_no_team: You don't have a team yet.
duel.panel_pending: ⏳ Your team is waiting for every invitee to accept.
duel.builder_desc:
1. **👤 Player**: add yourself, you'll be the lead
2. **➕ Teammates**: pick your friends ({max} players max)
3. **✏️ Name**, color and number of duels
4. **✅ Finish**: your teammates get an invitation
duel.builder_mates_hint: Pick up to **{max}** teammates. They will have to accept the invitation.
duel.builder_pick_lifetime: ⏳ Number of duels for the team
duel.team_ready_hint: Your team is ready. Challenge another team with `/duel <team> <rounds>`.
duel.team_footer: Duel team · temporary, not a clan
duel.inv_desc:
{leader} invites you to the duel team {team}.
The team will exist once everyone has accepted.
duel.inv_footer: Expires in {minutes} min · a duel team is not a clan
duel.inv_sent: Invitations sent in {thread}. The team will be ready once everyone has accepted.
duel.inv_already: ✅ You already accepted: waiting for the others.
duel.inv_ready_ping: ✅ {leader}, everyone accepted: your team is ready. Challenge a team with `/duel <team> <rounds>`.
duel.inv_expired: ⌛ Invitation expired: team {team} was not created.
duel.pick_desc: Pick the opposing team. Only teams of **{size}** player(s) with no duel in progress are listed.
duel.no_rival: No other team of {size} player(s) is available right now.
duel.req_desc: Team {team} led by {leader} challenges your team {target} to a **{size} vs {size}**.
duel.req_footer: Only the challenged team's lead can answer · expires in {minutes} min
duel.req_not_for_you: ❌ Only the challenged team's lead can answer.
duel.req_accepted_desc: {team} vs {target}: the duel voice channel is being set up.
duel.req_cancelled: ✖️ Challenge cancelled: one of the teams no longer exists.
duel.lobby_desc:
Join {voice}: it is open only to this duel's players.
The duel starts as soon as everyone is there. If not everyone has joined within **{minutes} min**, it is cancelled.
duel.launching: Everyone is here: the duel is about to begin!
duel.started_footer: The duel ends when nobody is left in voice, or with the End the duel button
duel.rematch_hint: 🔁 To play again, **every player** clicks **Rematch** within {minutes} minutes. A rematch doesn't use up a duel.

duel.rematch_gone: ❌ This rematch is no longer available.

duel.end_team_dissolved: {team} played its last duel: the team is disbanded.

duel.cfg_desc:
Pick **the category** where the `duel-01`, `duel-02`… voice channels will be created and **the requests channel** that will hold the private threads, then enable duels.

Players must be able to **see** that channel (they don't need to write in it). Voice channels and threads are deleted at the end of each duel.
duel.cfg_missing: ❌ Pick the category and the requests channel first.
duel.win_hint: 🏆 Both leads declare the winner with the buttons: it is recorded once their choices match.
duel.win_vote_saved: Vote saved: {team}. Waiting for the other lead.
duel.win_conflict: ⚠️ Vote saved: {team}, but the other lead picked the other team. Agree with each other: the winner is recorded once both choices match.
duel.win_not_lead: ❌ Only the two teams' leads (or an administrator) can declare the winner.
duel.win_gone: ❌ This duel is no longer waiting for a winner.
duel.close_not_lead: ❌ Only the two teams' leads (or an administrator) can close this duel.
duel.close_busy: ❌ A duel is running in this thread: end it first with 🏁 **{button}**.
